audit_protocol_delta.reason: S18-S27 follow the corrected paragraph protocol; defended content is not rewritten for cosmetic churn.

carry_forward_constraints: S28 must use actual pytest collection/execution for properties, doubles and integration tests; print-only booleans such as param_ok/neg_ok are not evidence.
Use IANA/RFC-reserved synthetic domains such as .test or example.com; do not reuse @example.pe as a supposedly safe non-routable fixture namespace.

Do not treat N2/CF-2 as passed. Preserve a small inherited regression pack for S26 critical controls: cycle detection, positive HITL approval, exact-draft approval binding, idempotency/restart, compensation history, retry classification and observed E2E promotion manifests.
S28 properties must target actual public APIs such as normalize_name/exact_match rather than testing inline expressions; define missing/Unicode/input contracts before generating cases.
Validate matching scores as finite and within the declared range before any property or threshold test; NaN/infinity/out-of-range must fail closed rather than silently classify.
Use real pytest fixtures/factories/scopes and teardown. Remember pytest also has package scope; wider mutable fixtures require explicit reset/lifecycle, not a blanket read-only API rule.

Keep filesystem integration real when that is the boundary under test by using tmp_path; do not over-mock controlled local I/O merely to make tests 'unit'. Clean every delete=False resource on success and failure.
Separate Coverage.py/pytest-cov branch measurement from a business-risk scenario matrix. Both are useful; manual output-category counts are not branch coverage.

Threshold tests must assert exact labels just below/at/just above every decision boundary and include missing/invalid/nonfinite scores; approximate equality belongs to computed numeric values, not threshold semantics.
Mutation evidence requires executing the unchanged test suite against mutated production code. Directly comparing mutant output to the oracle is not a killed mutant.
Every bug-regression example carried into S28 should preserve red-before-fix and green-after-fix evidence with the permanent test/node id.
Distinguish a behavioral contract/specification in tests from provider-consumer interface contract testing; S28 should introduce the latter explicitly when discussing module/service contracts.

Preserve unresolved S21-S26 provenance: integration fakes/mocks must not turn unverified upstream success/approved/model/review labels into green tests without validating the contract fields they stand for.
